events.text: Root causes found. (1) Key spam: primitiveModelPackage/playerModelPackage/buildStarterModelPackage seed a SHARED folderId ('props'/'models-characters'/'models-build') so every unsaved fresh model in a session renders the same content-tree key; also an empty-name save slugs to '' and claimed the props CATEGORY ROOT (stray props/manifest.json id-colliding with Model_27). (2) 10s layer toggle: paintLayerSetVisible -> replayAll re-rasterizes the whole stroke program; the keyboard blob holds 69,618 OP_FILLs (fill tool records one fill per pointer-move per face, no dedupe) of which only 3,664 are last-writer-effective (fills are hard overwrites). Fix in flight via codex: replay-side last-fill-wins skip + lazy material-ink bake + record-side dedupe + unique folderIds + empty-slug guard.

resolution: Both bugs root-caused and fixed in dd12f296c (planned by Claude, executed by codex sol against a pinned spec, graded against snapshots + fresh unit gate). Key spam: fresh primitive/player/build-starter packages all seeded a SHARED per-kind folderId so two unsaved models in one session rendered duplicate content-tree keys; they now derive modelFolderIdFor(id) like disk packages, and nameDirFor falls back to the id-slug home so an empty-name save can never claim the category root again (that bug already left a stray props/manifest.json colliding with Model_27 — cleanup pending user approval). 10s layer toggle: replayAll re-rasterizes the whole stroke program and the keyboard blob carries 69,618 OP_FILLs (fill tool records per pointer-move per face); fills are hard overwrites so only the last per face shows — new paint_ops.redundantFillOffsets skips 94.7% of them byte-exactly, ink now applies lazily (no GPU material bakes for skipped ops), and recordFill dedupes at record time. Gate: zig build test-paint-ops (8 tests) + zig build app compile + esbuild transform checks, all green. Zig change needs the user's next rebuild to land in the running editor.
